summary: Round 3 focused pass on the new numerology + tarot engines (backend-only). 19/20 pytest tests pass. Numerology: auth is enforced (401), full chart returned with numbers {life_path,expression,soul_urge,personality,birthday,maturity} and per-key chart entries {number,title,keywords,meaning,dimension}; master numbers 11 and 33 preserved for the agent-verified sample 'Ria Ahuja' 2000-11-29 (life_path=6, expression=33, birthday=11); invalid dob ('notadate', '2000-13-40') -> 400; empty name '' -> 422 (Pydantic min_length), whitespace-only name '   ' -> 400 from the engine; all numbers land inside the valid range {1..9,11,22,33} for a normal name. Tarot: /api/tarot/deck returns count=78 with 22 Major + 4x14 Minor, unique ids, all cards have upright/reversed/keywords; spreads = {single,three,situation,five}; /api/tarot/draw returns the correct number of unique cards per spread (1/3/3/5), every card has a valid orientation and the meaning matches the source card's upright/reversed text; invalid spread rejected (422); unauth -> 401. Regression sanity: /oracle/consult never emits 'general' topic and returns short ELI5 answers; /oracle/illustrate produces a real PNG (>10KB, image/png) served via /api/img/{key}.png; /owner/overview is 403 for customer and 200 for owner. Found ONE real bug: numerology.reading crashes with 500 (KeyError: 0 in _entry) when the full name has no vowels (or no consonants), because _sum_letters returns 0 and NUMBER_ESSENCE has no entry for 0.

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error for names with no vowels (e.g. full_name='K K'). Root cause: numerology._sum_letters returns 0 when the filtered letter set is empty; _entry(0) then hits NUMBER_ESSENCE[_reduce(0)] which raises KeyError: 0. Same failure mode applies to names with no consonants (e.g. 'AEI OU'). Fix: after summing letters, if total==0 either raise ValueError('Please provide a name with at least one vowel and one consonant') (-> 400) or fall back to 9/1 in _entry with a guarded lookup. Repro: POST /api/numerology/reading {"full_name":"K K","dob":"1984-04-04"} with a valid bearer -> 500. Stack: /app/backend/numerology.py:83 in _entry.

minor.issue: Empty full_name returns 422 (Pydantic min_length=1) instead of the 400 stated in the request. Whitespace-only name correctly returns 400. If a uniform 400 is desired, either drop min_length and let the engine's ValueError raise, or convert the RequestValidationError into 400 in a handler.

action_items: Guard numerology._entry against 0 (or short-circuit in _sum_letters) so names without vowels or without consonants do not 500. Simple fix: `if not _letters(...): raise ValueError('Please provide a full name with vowels and consonants')` in reading() before computing soul_urge/personality, OR make _entry fall back to _entry(9) when num==0.
Optional: normalise empty-name response to 400 (currently 422 from Pydantic) for symmetry with the invalid-dob path.
critical_code_review_comments: numerology._reduce loops on n>9 unless in MASTERS; safe, but there is no guard for n==0 (empty letter set) — the current KeyError is the direct symptom.
numerology.reading validates the full name via _letters() presence but never validates that both vowels and consonants exist; soul_urge/personality can silently become 0.
tarot.draw sets reversed with probability 0.35 via random.random() — deterministic seeding is not exposed, so tests must cross-check upright/reversed text via the deck endpoint (already done).
server.NumerologyBody uses Field(min_length=1); this makes '' fail with 422 from FastAPI validation, which is inconsistent with the '400 on empty name' expectation in the review request.
server.py is still ~828 lines; the numerology/tarot routers could live in a routes/ package to keep files under 700 lines (previously flagged, still open).
seed_data_creation: None. All calls are read/compute-only against the new engines.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New tests file: /app/backend/tests/test_numerology_tarot.py. Env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (see /app/frontend/.env). Ria Ahuja / 2000-11-29 is the golden numerology sample (life_path=6, expression=33, birthday=11). Tarot deck must stay at 78, 22 Major + 14 per suit; SPREADS keys must remain {single,three,situation,five} with sizes 1/3/3/5. The one open bug is the no-vowel KeyError in numerology._entry; once fixed, re-run test_name_without_vowels_no_500 for green.
rca_of_issue: RCA: POST /api/numerology/reading with a name containing no vowels (e.g. 'K K') sends the request through numerology.reading -> _sum_letters(name,'vowels') -> the filter drops every character -> total=0 -> _reduce(0)=0 -> reading() builds numbers['soul_urge']=0 -> _entry(0) executes `NUMBER_ESSENCE.get(0) or NUMBER_ESSENCE[_reduce(0)]`. Since NUMBER_ESSENCE has no key 0 and _reduce(0)=0, the fallback lookup raises KeyError: 0. FastAPI surfaces this as 500. Same path is triggered for consonant-less names (e.g. 'AEI OU'). Reproduction: `curl -s -X POST $URL/api/numerology/reading -H 'Authorization: Bearer <cust>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"full_name":"K K","dob":"1984-04-04"}'` -> 500. Mitigation: add an explicit guard in reading() (`if total==0: raise ValueError(...)`) or make _entry tolerate 0 by falling back to _entry(9). Prefer the 400-with-friendly-message approach so callers see actionable validation.
